import.title: Import resources
import.explanation: Copy pipelines, agent profiles, instructions and tools from another project into {{project}}. Each copy is an independent local draft that records where it came from: nothing is published or run, and later edits in the source never reach it.
import.secretsReason: Secrets are not imported: a secret's value stays in its own project.
import.dependencyNote: Selecting a pipeline includes its dependencies for review in the next step.

blocked.noSources: There is no other project to import from.
blocked.noSource: Choose a project to import from.
blocked.name: Name the copy of {{name}} to continue.

empty.noSourcesText: Orchester knows no other project yet. Add one to import its resources here.
empty.readingText: Orchester reads its pipelines, agent profiles, instructions and tools. Nothing in {{project}} changes.
empty.nothingText: {{project}} has no pipelines, agent profiles, instructions or tools yet.
empty.kindText: {{project}} has none of these yet. Pick another kind.
empty.noMatchText: Nothing in {{project}} is called {{search}}. Clear the search or pick another kind.
empty.secretsText: A secret's value stays in its own project. When you import a tool, its secret is mapped to one of {{project}}'s in Resolve dependencies, or left unresolved.

offerDetail.nameBeside: Name the copy in the field beside

planned.importSecretReason: A secret's value stays in its own project · not available yet
planned.supplyValueReason: Enter a value for {{project}}, masked · not available yet
planned.authorizeReason: Importing never grants access; add the server in Connections · not available yet

statusDetail.renamed: Copy of {{name}} under a new name
statusDetail.anotherCopy: Another copy in this import is called {{name}}
statusDetail.enterName: Enter a name for the copy

import.accessNote: A connection or secret is never copied, so access does not move between projects: map it to one of {{project}}'s, or leave it unresolved and the copies show it as missing. No credential value is shown or copied.

readiness.readyUnresolved: Creates local drafts · unresolved connections, MCP servers and secrets show as missing

ready.title: Ready to create local drafts
ready.detail: {{context}}. Nothing runs and nothing is published: each copy starts as a draft you review and publish yourself.

missing.secretOne: {{users}} shows the secret as missing until it selects one of {{project}}'s.
missing.secretOther: {{users}} show the secret as missing until they select one of {{project}}'s.
missing.mcpServer: shows as missing until one of {{project}}'s MCP servers is chosen.
missing.connection: shows as missing until one of {{project}}'s connections is chosen.

policy.title: Target access policy
policy.detail: Copied tools keep access only for pipelines copied with them. Every other caller is denied.
policy.notApplied: Access rules · not applied yet: environment and approval for each deployment are planned.

authorized.title: Authorized in {{project}}
authorized.detail: Importing never grants access. Copies use {{project}}'s own connections and secrets; what is left unresolved stays missing until you choose one in {{project}}.

import.provenance: Each copy records its source project, resource and version. Later edits in {{project}} never reach it.

result.title: Imported from {{project}}
result.summary: {{totals}}. Nothing is published and nothing runs until you review and publish.
result.independent: An independent copy: later edits in {{project}} never reach it.
result.missingNote: The copies show them as missing until you choose {{project}}'s own.

failed.title: Could not import from {{project}}
failed.detail: The drafts could not be created; nothing was imported. Your choices are kept: Try again repeats this import and never creates a copy twice.
failed.changedTitle: This project changed while you chose
failed.changedDetail: Check the mappings, then import again. A row whose choice is gone asks you to choose again.
failed.refusedDetail: Access to {{folder}} was refused; nothing was imported. Your choices are kept. Check the folder's permissions, then try again.
failed.invalidCopy: A copy could not be prepared. The log has the details.
